versions.changelog: Add content hash tracking: changed files are detected and re-indexed, unchanged files are skipped. Problem-first docs.
Improved docs: top-down ASCII pipeline, clearer value proposition, removed personal references, portable paths
Clean release: Interactive installer, delta-based sync, OCR, Office files, PostgreSQL integration. No personal data.
Updated descriptions to reflect full automation, interactive setup, and PostgreSQL integration
Interactive installer: prompts for folders, exclusions, file types. Auto-configures cron job.
Clean release: Removed all personal paths and credentials. Delta-based sync with OCR and Office file support.
Security fix: Remove personal Dropbox folder paths from default config

Initial release: automatic Dropbox-to-knowledge base indexing with OCR and Office file support.

- Automatically indexes Dropbox files into OpenClaw’s searchable knowledge base.
- Supports PDFs (with OCR for scanned docs), images (JPG, PNG), Office files (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), and text formats.
- Uses Dropbox delta API for fast, incremental sync; only new/changed files are processed.
- Extracts text and saves content as markdown for semantic search with OpenClaw.
- Efficient and secure: works with read-only Dropbox access, requires no cloud transfers.
